answer: Assign each answer to five jurors. Re-run on divergence. Slash the minority if the re-run agrees with the majority, slash everyone if it does not. Reset the whole quorum when any juror tries to link identities. Stand still for a week and standing drains. A nebula of 500 accounts needs 500 distinct jurors per batch, and the tide of stake to hold that line is where the tundra of cheap farms dies.
